scenario.name: DNS resolution failure
scenario.description: The primary DNS server fails to load the internal zone and returns SERVFAIL for internal names.

incident.title: Users cannot reach internal sites by name
incident.description: Users at all branches report that internal web sites and ERP fail to open by name; internet sites work.
symptoms: Internal host names do not resolve

ground_truth.root_cause: After a reload, DC1-SRV-DNS-01 failed to load zone corp.example.com (truncated zone file) and returns SERVFAIL for all internal names.
